# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Security fixes are provided for the latest release of the Clockify extension.
Older releases are not supported. Before reporting a vulnerability, please
verify that it is still present in the latest release available from
[GitHub Releases](https://github.com/tobiaswaelde/vscode-clockify/releases/latest).

| Version | Supported |
| --- | --- |
| Latest release | Yes |
| Older releases | No |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please do not disclose suspected vulnerabilities in a public issue,
discussion, or pull request.

Report vulnerabilities privately through
[GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting](https://github.com/tobiaswaelde/vscode-clockify/security/advisories/new).
Include as much of the following information as possible:

- A description of the vulnerability and its potential impact
- The affected extension version and environment
- Steps or a minimal example that reproduce the issue
- Any known mitigations or suggested fixes

You will receive an acknowledgement after the report has been reviewed. The
maintainer will coordinate validation, remediation, release, and disclosure
with you through the private advisory.

This policy covers the Clockify VS Code extension and its release artifacts.
Vulnerabilities in the Clockify service itself should be reported directly to
Clockify through its official security channels.
